instrument: drum kit (kick ~57 Hz, deep snare with ghost notes) + shaker; no hi-hat, cymbals or toms
notes_ja: 1〜10小節目は休み。11小節目後半のスネアのフィル（弱い6番目→7・9・11・12番目の8分）で入ります。キックは8分の1・4・7・9・11番目が基本ですが、小節によって7番目や9番目が抜けるので譜面どおりに踏み分けてください。スネアは7番目（3拍目）のバックビートで、ほとんどの小節は1拍目にもキックと一緒にスネア（小節により普通の音量かゴースト）が重なります。ゴーストノートはAもBも同じ型で8分の3・6・10・12番目（3番目がいちばん強く、6番目はごく弱いので最初は省略してかまいません）。Aセクション（12〜21小節）の10・12番目のゴーストはヴァイオリンに隠れて原曲ではほとんど聞こえないので、慣れるまでは省略してもかまいません。シェイカー（ハイハットで代用可）は12小節目から最後まで8分の奇数番目（1・3・5・7・9・11番目）を一定に刻みます（24小節目だけ6・10・12番目にも追加）。19・21・27・30・33小節目はスネアのフィルなので、手順（R/L）を先に決めておくと安定します。
method: v3 (re-verified against the BS-RoFormer SW 6-stem drums stem, cross-checked with htdemucs_6s and the earlier htdemucs 4-stem drums, the Mega-53 acoustic-guitar and violin stems and the mix). Kit: kick (~57 Hz ring), one deep snare (65-78 Hz body + ~540 Hz head ring, panned slightly right) with ghost notes, and a shaker (rounded 8-13 kHz swells peaking ~20 ms after the grid). Every slot of bars 11-34 was measured on 0.5-eighth steps: band rises (30-90 Hz, 90-250, 250-1k, 1-4k, 5-9k, 9-16k), Hilbert peak/background in 150-1000 Hz and 1.5-6 kHz, 8-16 kHz late/early window energy (shaker), 57 vs 75 Hz ring (kick vs snare body), low-pass waveform shape, stereo balance per band, and onset micro-timing; ambiguous slots were inspected as band-passed waveforms and spectrograms (work/v3/drums3/*.png). Everything is on the eighth grid (no sixteenths). Bars 1-10 tacet (the SW6 drum stem is silent there). Scores (onsets() of the stem vs part times, 50 ms window, +10 ms lag): SW6 stem full band F=0.943 (P 0.89, R 1.00), 1-4 kHz F=0.963, 7-11 kHz (shaker+snare) F=0.823; htdemucs_6s full F=0.941; htdemucs 4-stem full F=0.869. Per bar (SW6, full band): 11:1.00 12:1.00 13:0.95 14:1.00 15:1.00 16:1.00 17:1.00 18:0.95 19:0.95 20:0.82 21:0.89 22:0.82 23:1.00 24:0.89 25:0.89 26:0.89 27:0.95 28:0.95 29:1.00 30:0.95 31:0.82 32:1.00 33:0.95 34:0.93. Detector-matched (onsets() of synth_drums(part) vs of the stem): SW6 F=0.869. Chroma does not apply to unpitched percussion. Uncertain: the very soft eighth-6 (pos 5) ghosts (clear in 150-1000 Hz in all three separations but near the noise floor above 1.5 kHz) and the A-section eighth-10/12 ghosts, which only the BS-RoFormer stem shows clearly (see verification_v3).
verification: v3 INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION (verifier agent, 2026-11-18; scripts and images in work/v3/vdrums/; backup of the checked file: parts_v3/drums.pre_verify.json). VERDICT: the transcriber's 233 events are confirmed. No event was added, removed, moved or reclassified, so the event list is identical before and after this check. CHANGED: (1) chords: drums.json still carried the v2 chord names (Csus2 at 13b/15b/17b, Asus4 at 24b/30b/33b, Esus4 at 27b), while parts_v3/chords.json and the verified bass.json now use Csus4(add9), Asus2 (24b), Asus4/E (27b) and A (30b/33b); the chord list was copied from chords.json (sections were already identical). (2) notes_ja: one sentence added saying that the A-section ghosts on eighths 10/12 (1-based) are masked by the violin in the record and can be left out at first. EVIDENCE. Stems and tools used differ from the transcriber's main one (the BS-RoFormer SW drum stem): the MIX itself (mid/side analysis), htdemucs_6s drums, the htdemucs 4-stem drums, and the Mega acoustic-guitar and violin stems as leakage references. Tools: 8-16 kHz shaker-swell detector (peak in +5..+45 ms against the minimum in -40..0 ms, with peak time), mid/side band energies, Hilbert peak/background per band (30-90 Hz, 150-1000 Hz, 1.5-6 kHz, 8-16 kHz), a spectral-valley flux on the mix (energy rise between violin/guitar partials), whitened fine-spectrum correlation of the drum bursts with the violin and guitar stems, per-slot peak-timing statistics, and bar rasters (vdrums/ras_hf.png, ras_wire.png, sa_hf.png). (1) A-SECTION SHAKER (46 added notes): confirmed without using any drum separation. In the MIX at eighth 4 (1-based 5; no kick, snare or guitar strum in most A bars) the 8-16 kHz level / rise / peak time is -54.3 dB / 3.6 dB / +8 ms in the intro (guitar and violin, no drums), -46.2 / 7.3 / +24 ms in A and -46.9 / 7.2 / +26 ms in B, where the shaker is undisputed. So A has the same level and the same late, rounded swell as the B shaker. The acoustic-guitar stem at A eighth 4 is -59.9 dB, 14 dB below the mix, with a rise of only 3.5 dB. In A the acoustic guitar is a decorrelated left/right pair (1.5-6 kHz L/R correlation 0.04, mid = side), whereas in the intro it is almost mono (0.88). The centred (mid minus side) 8-16 kHz energy at A eighth 4 is -50.4 dB, close to -49.9 dB at B eighth 4 and far above the guitar stem's centred part (-70 dB). In htdemucs_6s (a different model family from BS-RoFormer) the shaker swell at A even eighths rises 9-37 dB (median 20; eighth 4: 11-21 dB in every bar 12-21) with a +23 ms peak at eighth 4 (B: +26 ms), against a median of 2 dB (max 11) at the empty eighths 1/7. The 4-stem drums have nothing there (A eighth 4 at -82 dB), which confirms the transcriber's explanation of why v2 missed it. Gap fills 21:2, 21:8 and 34:4: htdemucs_6s swell 19.2, 17.2 and 8.1 dB. 34:4 is weaker in htdemucs_6s near the end of the clip, but it is 16 dB in SW6 and the mix peak is at +27 ms (shaker timing). Bar 24 extras (eighths 5/9/11): htdemucs_6s 22.4/23.2/17.7 dB against -1..15 dB at the same eighths in other B bars, so they are kept. (2) GHOST NOTES (31 added). Eighth 5 (1-based 6) is supported by all three separations in 150-1000 Hz: rises in bars 12-21 are 12.8-24.5 dB (SW6), 11.6-27.6 dB (htdemucs_6s) and 3.8-28.4 dB (4-stem), against a median of 5 dB at the empty eighths. A-section eighths 9 and 11 (1-based 10 and 12): (a) the SW6 bursts have the same 150-1000 Hz peak level as the consensus B ghosts (-22.6..-27.9 dB at A:9 against -23.8..-28.8 at B:9). (b) Their fine spectrum does not copy the violin or guitar partials (whitened-spectrum correlation -0.33..0.01 with the violin stem and -0.12..0.35 with the guitar stem, the same as at consensus ghosts and empty slots). (c) They are locked to the grid like real hits: the 1.5-6 kHz peak-time IQR is 2.3 ms (A:9) and 2.5 ms (A:11), against 0.6 ms for the accepted A eighth-2 ghosts and 1.9/2.9 ms for B:9/B:11, while empty eighths 1/7 in A scatter by 8.5-10.2 ms. (d) The Demucs stems under-report ALL soft snare energy in A, including the v2-accepted eighth-2 ghosts. Measured as the SW6 peak minus the stem peak in 150-1000 Hz, eighth-2 ghosts are 10.6 dB (htdemucs_6s) and 11.2 dB (4-stem) lower in A, against 3.3/2.5 dB in B. For A:9/11 the gap is larger (14-19 dB, B: 0.7-3.0 dB). So these ghosts rest mainly on SW6, and their 'medium' confidence is right. 73 of the 77 added notes have an onset (any band) in at least one Demucs stem. The four shown only by SW6 are the ghosts 13:11, 17:11 and 18:9, and the shaker 16:4, whose htdemucs_6s swell is 16.4 dB (only the onset detector misses it). In the mix the A ghosts on 9/11 are masked: the spectral-valley rise at the no-strum slots 13:9, 15:9, 17:9, 13:11 and 17:11 is 0.7-4.3 dB, about the empty-slot level. Hence the new practice note. Downbeat ghosts 17:0/19:0: 1.5-6 kHz peak -36.0/-31.6 dB in SW6 and -39.7/-40.6 dB in htdemucs_6s. That is above both the A eighth-3 kicks (SW6 -56..-43, htdemucs_6s -52..-43) and the A eighth-4 shaker hits (SW6 -54..-47, htdemucs_6s -62..-52), and at the level of the v2 ghosts at 14:0/15:0 (SW6 -34.5/-30.7, htdemucs_6s -41.8/-38.6). They are kept. (3) KICKS AND BACKBEATS unchanged and confirmed. The htdemucs_6s 30-90 Hz rise is 8-32 dB (median 17) at every notated kick except 34:8, and at most 4.1 dB at 12:8, 16:8 and 17:8 (no kick there). 34:8 rises only 4-5 dB in 30-90 Hz in all three stems, because the 34:6 kick is still ringing and the clip fades out from about 51.45 s. Its 95-160 Hz kick sweep jumps 17.1/16.6/21.0 dB (SW6/htdemucs_6s/4-stem), against 18-28 dB for 34:6, 33:8 and 34:3, so it is a real, soft kick and is kept. The snare-only backbeats 13:6, 14:6, 18:6 and 19:6 were left as v2 and v3 have them. (4) NOTHING MISSED. Every slot with an onset rise in at least two of the three drum stems is notated, except two kinds of event. Very soft (-50..-61 dB) half-eighth events at x:5.5 and x:11.5 appear mainly in the Demucs stems (SW6 rise 2-9 dB) and are probably guitar or shaker bleed. Low-mid smears at 19:7 and 25:7 have no 1.5-6 kHz attack. Neither kind is notated. No sixteenths are needed. Bars 1-10 and 11:0-11:4 are tacet: all three drum stems read -65..-127 dB, and the drums enter at 11:5 in every stem. METRICS (onsets() of each stem, 50 ms window, +10 ms lag; v2 -> v3, which is also the after-verification state). htdemucs_6s: full band F 0.935 -> 0.941 (A section 0.863 -> 0.895, recall 0.78 -> 1.00); 150-1000 Hz vs kick/snare/ghosts 0.901 -> 0.943 (A 0.838 -> 0.925); 7-16 kHz vs shaker/snare 0.684 -> 0.799 (A 0.478 -> 0.808). 4-stem: 150-1000 Hz 0.908 -> 0.936 (A 0.844 -> 0.907), although its full band falls 0.962 -> 0.869 because that stem has no A shaker. Evidence re-derived for every bar 11-34 from audio/stems/drums.wav: per-slot band features (1-4 kHz and 7-13 kHz Hilbert envelopes: peak relative to the section backbeat and rise above the local floor; 150-1000 Hz spectral flux; 95-160 Hz kick pitch-sweep onset jump), a two-template matching pursuit on the <180 Hz waveform (kick template averaged from the eighth-3 kicks, which correlate 0.95-0.99 with each other, plus a snare-body template taken from the bar-11 fill), cross-correlation of the low waveforms between slots, bar-averaged spectrograms for A and B, and the stem's own onsets() detector (full band and 1-4 kHz) against the part. The low end matches the snare-only backbeats of 13:6 and 18:6: matching-pursuit kick amplitude is -13 dB (true kick+snare backbeats are -5 to +2 dB), low-band RMS is 0.045 (snare-only 0.038-0.046, kick+snare 0.066-0.10), and it correlates 0.80-0.84 with the bar-11 snare-only hits but only 0.47-0.49 with 20:6 and 21:6. Every B bar has a soft hit on eighth 5: onsets() detects it in 22, 23, 25, 26, 28, 29, 31 and 33 (full band) and in 32 and 34 (1-4 kHz).
